Let $A$ be the given matrix:
$$ A = \left(\begin{array}{ccc} -4 & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 \end{array}\right) $$
The characteristic polynomial $p_A(\lambda)$ is given by $\det(A - \lambda I)$, where $I$ is the identity matrix. Therefore,
$$ A - \lambda I = \left(\begin{array}{ccc} -4-\lambda & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10-\lambda & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14-\lambda \end{array}\right) $$
Now we calculate the determinant:
\begin{align*} p_A(\lambda) &= \det(A - \lambda I) \\ &= (-4-\lambda)((10-\lambda)(-14-\lambda) - (-5)(4)) - (-13)((-9)(-14-\lambda) - (12)(4)) + 10((-9)(-5) - (12)(10-\lambda)) \\ &= (-4-\lambda)((-140 - 10\lambda + 14\lambda + \lambda^2) + 20) - (-13)(126 + 9\lambda - 48) + 10(45 - 120 + 12\lambda) \\ &= (-4-\lambda)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) + 13(78 + 9\lambda) + 10(-75 + 12\lambda) \\ &= (-4-\lambda)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) + 1014 + 117\lambda - 750 + 120\lambda \\ &= -4\lambda^2 - 16\lambda + 480 - \lambda^3 - 4\lambda^2 + 120\lambda + 264 + 237\lambda \\ &= -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 224\lambda + 480 + 264 + 237\lambda \\ &= -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 461\lambda + 744\end{aligned}
Therefore, $p_A(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 461\lambda + 744$.
Thus, the characteristic polynomial is
$$p_A(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 461\lambda + 744$$

$\boxed{-\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 461\lambda + 744}$
